en: Black‑and‑white image showing an old suspension bridge with massive stone pylons spanning a wide river. A tram runs along the embankment in the foreground, and ornate lampposts and railings line the riverside. On the bridge towers there is a coat of arms, and on both the bridge and the riverbank there are signs reading "VÁMHÁZ." Historic multi‑storey buildings with towers are visible on the far bank.
